card.name: Right before 'per' or 'each' rate phrases
card.fires_on: The last word of a quantity or unit just before a rate word such as per, each, or daily. It fires on units, counts, and plural nouns after a number, where a rate phrase is expected next.

modes.label: Count or unit before per
modes.description: A noun or unit after a number, where 'per' comes next.
modes.example: speeds of over 1,000<< kilometers>> per second

modes.label: Plural patients before per
modes.description: A plural noun or word ending that leads into 'per' a population or time span.
modes.example: APPROXIMATELY SIX PATIENT<<S>> PER ONE MILLION POPULATION PER YEAR

modes.label: Frequency phrases
modes.description: Words that start a frequency or timing phrase such as twice daily or before use.

card.writes: It promotes 'each' and 'every' words in several languages, which suggests a rate or per-unit phrase comes next.
card.plain: It marks the spot right before a phrase like 'per' or 'each', such as 'per second' or 'each day'.
